purpose: Active draw.io-agent Development and Validation tasks spanning creation, structural editing, visual/OCR reconstruction, source scoping, version safety, failure-state rendering and citation-grounded policy diagrams. v2 remains historical.

tasks.request: Create a draw.io diagram that recommends diagram types for system interactions and responsibility handoffs.

requiredClaims.description: System interactions use a Sequence Diagram.
Responsibility handoffs use a Swimlane Diagram.

tasks.request: Create the evidence-to-canvas request route as an editable draw.io flow.

requiredClaims.description: The route is SCOPE SOURCES to RETRIEVE EVIDENCE to BUILD PLAN to COMPOSE CANVAS.

tasks.request: Change cell fact-1 to state that draw.io XML is the canonical editable result. Add cell revalidation-note with label Factual edits require evidence revalidation. Preserve the export note and its edge, and set fact-1 attribute evidenceSourceVersion to drawio-workflow-handbook:v1.

A factual node edit requires evidence revalidation.

preserveCellValues.policy-v1: Existing evidence remains pinned to V1

requiredClaims.description: The existing evidence remains pinned to V1 when reopened.

tasks.request: Create an editable draw.io diagram of the scanned Evidence Board budgets with three connected stage nodes: Candidate retrieval, Hydration, and Final bundle. Cite the scanned evidence.

requiredClaims.description: Candidate retrieval is 40, Hydration is 16, and Final bundle is 8.

tasks.request: Arrange the four existing nodes into two columns. Preserve every cell identifier and label; change only geometry.

requiredClaims.description: A pure two-column layout edit does not require new material retrieval.

tasks.request: Create an editable evidence-to-draft workflow from the handbook.

requiredClaims.description: The workflow runs from EVIDENCE BUNDLE through TYPED PLAN and LAYOUT CHECK to CANVAS DRAFT.

tasks.request: Create a decision diagram contrasting an explicitly selected material with automatic wider search.

requiredClaims.description: Explicit material restricts retrieval to that scope; wider authorized search requires automatic selection.

tasks.request: Create an editable funnel showing the candidate, hydration, and final evidence budgets.

requiredClaims.description: The baseline retrieves 40 candidates, hydrates at most 16, and includes at most 8 final evidence items.

tasks.request: Turn the scanned visual-verification checklist into an editable draw.io checklist.

requiredClaims.description: Scanned arrow direction, containment and raster cells require pixel verification, and the result needs stable IDs and valid XML.

tasks.request: Create a source-selection and degraded-search decision diagram from the scanned workshop notes.

requiredClaims.description: Explicit sources come first, removed sources cannot support new requests, and search interruption is degraded search rather than no evidence.

tasks.request: Recreate the datacenter capacity-change route as editable draw.io XML.

requiredClaims.description: The route is CAPACITY CHECK to CHANGE ORCHESTRATE to APPLY.

tasks.request: Create a threshold gate for escalation to human review.

requiredClaims.description: Human review starts only after utilization exceeds 85% for three consecutive samples.

tasks.request: Create the editable payment request route from acquisition through settlement.

requiredClaims.description: The request route is ACQUIRE to RISK DECISION to FX CONVERT to SETTLE.

tasks.request: Create the editable settlement sequence from clearing through notification.

requiredClaims.description: The settlement sequence is CLEARING to BANK ACK to RECONCILE to NOTIFY.

tasks.request: Create an editable failure-response matrix for vector search, object storage, and canvas save.

requiredClaims.description: Vector failure leaves manual drawing available but blocks material search; object-store and canvas-save failures are separately represented, with canvas save as SEV-1.

tasks.request: Create an editable SEV-1, SEV-2, and SEV-3 incident legend.

requiredClaims.description: SEV-1 covers possible cross-scope disclosure, SEV-2 covers tasks that cannot complete without data loss, and SEV-3 is a retryable delay with preserved work.

tasks.request: Convert the scanned B-16 audit finding into an editable threshold-and-status diagram.

requiredClaims.description: B-16 measured 27 mm with +6 mm growth, exceeding the 25 mm or +5 mm engineering-review threshold.

tasks.request: Create a version-selection diagram contrasting a new request with reopening an existing diagram.

requiredClaims.description: New requests default to the latest ready version, while reopened evidence remains pinned to V1.

tasks.request: Create a two-node policy diagram showing that explicit source selection wins.

requiredClaims.description: Explicit source selection wins.

tasks.request: Edit the existing approval flow so the Reviewer can review evidence but cannot manage chartbook shares. Preserve the Owner approval path and remove forbidden edge reviewer-share.

requiredClaims.description: A Reviewer cannot manage chartbook shares.

tasks.request: Create the release flow from draft through evidence review and publish.

requiredClaims.description: The release route is DRAFT to EVIDENCE REVIEW to OWNER APPROVAL to PUBLISH.

tasks.request: Add a cell with id temporary-reviewer and label Temporary Reviewer to the governed chartbook change. Preserve the existing Owner and change cells, and set the new cell attribute evidenceSourceVersion to drawio-collaboration-governance:v1.
tasks.inputXml: <mxGraphModel><root><mxCell id='0'/><mxCell id='1' parent='0'/><mxCell id='change' value='Governed chartbook change' vertex='1' parent='1'/><mxCell id='owner' value='Owner' vertex='1' parent='1'/><mxCell id='change-owner' edge='1' source='change' target='owner' parent='1'/></root></mxGraphModel>

requiredClaims.description: The governed change may include a Temporary Reviewer under the cited policy.

tasks.request: Create the editable OTA release route from repository to vehicle.

requiredClaims.description: The OTA route is VERSION REPO to CANARY CTRL to DISTRIBUTE to VEHICLE.

tasks.request: Create the editable OTA canary sequence.

requiredClaims.description: The canary sequence is BATCH START to HEALTH CHECK to EXPAND to COMPLETE.

tasks.request: Create a version-safe OTA diagram showing the rule for existing evidence.

requiredClaims.description: Existing OTA evidence remains pinned to its original version.

tasks.request: Create an approval-role diagram for OTA rollout and rollback advice.

requiredClaims.description: A quality reviewer may advise rollout or rollback but cannot approve alone.

tasks.request: Recreate the observability alert route as editable draw.io XML.

requiredClaims.description: The alert route is ALERT EVAL to ROUTE DISPATCH to NOTIFY.

tasks.request: Create an editable incident sequence showing what follows acknowledgement.

requiredClaims.description: DIAGNOSE follows ACK.

tasks.request: Create a degraded-collection state that cannot be mistaken for no alerts.

requiredClaims.description: An interrupted collection must be represented as degraded and not disguised as no alerts.

tasks.request: Create a material-source decision diagram for explicit, chartbook, and broader automatic scopes.

requiredClaims.description: Explicit selection is limited to that scope; otherwise chartbook materials are searched first and broader search requires automatic selection.

tasks.request: Create an access-boundary diagram for chartbook, cross-user, and removed materials.

requiredClaims.description: Retrieval is limited to mounted chartbook materials, never crosses users, and excludes removed material from new requests.

tasks.request: Create an editable version-conflict decision diagram.

requiredLabels: Do not apply new value to old-version shape

requiredClaims.description: Pinned evidence stays on that version; unavailable versions must be reported and new-version values cannot be applied to old-version shapes.

tasks.request: Create the editable solar commissioning route.

requiredClaims.description: The commissioning route starts PRECHECK to INSULATION TEST and finishes GRID SYNC to RUN.

tasks.request: Create an editable operating-parameter diagram for wait time, torque, and current.

requiredClaims.description: The procedure waits 7 minutes, uses 6.2 N m torque, and limits continuous AC current to 69 A.

tasks.request: Create a firmware and temperature safety-gate diagram.

requiredClaims.description: Firmware must be at least 4.7.2 and the temperature gate requires at least 82°C for three consecutive samples.

tasks.request: Create a role matrix for Editor approval and Reviewer share permissions.

requiredClaims.description: An Editor cannot approve a release; a Reviewer may review evidence but cannot manage shares.

tasks.request: Create a chartbook retrieval decision diagram.

requiredLabels: Broader search only with automatic selection

requiredClaims.description: Explicit material limits the request, removed material is blocked, chartbook material is searched first, and broader search requires automatic selection.

tasks.request: Create an editable governance timeline for retention and temporary reviewers.

requiredClaims.description: Governance records are retained for 36 months and Temporary Reviewer access lasts up to 8 hours.

tasks.request: Create an editable observability threshold and degraded-state diagram.

requiredClaims.description: Human confirmation requires three consecutive threshold breaches, while interrupted collection is represented as degraded.
